# CyberShield AI

> Autonomous multi-agent cybersecurity platform that detects, investigates, and responds to cyber threats in real time through collaborating specialist AI agents.

CyberShield AI orchestrates seven specialist agents (Threat Detection, Threat Intelligence, Malware Analysis, Risk Assessment, Compliance, Incident Response, Reporting) that share context and reach a unified verdict on suspicious indicators — emails, URLs, domains, IPs, and files.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview, architecture, agents, workflow, and live multi-agent collaboration demo.
- [Live Investigation](/investigation): Submit a suspicious indicator and watch seven autonomous agents investigate in real time.
